subject: Eval Runway — Weekly sprint report & POC milestone stalls
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Connor <leah.connor@finera.com>, finera-ops@finera.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Eval Runway — Weekly sprint report & POC milestone stalls

Hi Leah + team,

Quick MAP checkpoint after today's stand — pulling out the items that changed since last week and the open blockers that are driving the POC timeline:

Summary (TL;DR)
- Acceptance gating slipped: perf target for 2x concurrent sessions not met on the latest image.
- Two action owners identified to unblock: Karthik (runtime tweaks) and Finera ops (client-side session config).
- Next gate: smoke acceptance run scheduled for Fri 05/07; must hit <= 220ms p50 for 512 tokens to stay on close timeline.

Open blocker details
- Serving kernel mismatch: trace shows frequent kernel fallbacks under simultaneous KV cache pressure (attached trace-sample-20270502.txt). Karthik to investigate quantization fallback path and advise config change by EOD Wed.
- Client keepalive: Finera's load generator is opening aggressive short-lived connections; finera-ops to test keeping connections warm (suggested setting below).

Action items (owners / ETA)
- Karthik Iyer: run targeted kernel profile and provide a patch or config by 2027-05-04 EOD.
- finera-ops@finera.com: validate connection keepalive and run 2nd replay with warm connections by 2027-05-05.
- Marissa Cole: update MAP spreadsheet with revised acceptance gating and call out risk for close (see MAP_v1.3.xlsx). Due 2027-05-04.

Acceptance criteria reminder (from our MAP):
- Functional: all required endpoints return responses with <2% error rate under test load.
- Performance: p50 <= 220ms, p95 <= 650ms for 512-token baseline.
- Resilience: no fallback to CPU for >0.1% of token generations.

I'll hold a 30-min sync on Thu 05/06 8:30am PT to go over Karthik's findings and the replay results — invite sent.

Attachments: MAP_v1.3.xlsx, trace-sample-20270502.txt, acceptance-checklist-v2.md

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Lead, Strategic POCs
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

From: Leah Connor <leah.connor@finera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finera-ops@finera.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval Runway — Weekly sprint report & POC milestone stalls

Thanks, Irene. Confirmed on our side — we saw the same fallback signatures during yesterday's replay. A couple notes from ops:

- We'll run the warm-connection replay tomorrow morning and share logs by EOD.
- Regarding keepalive: our current load-generator config drops connections after 3s idle; changing to 60s warm sockets is low risk for us. We'll validate for the replay.

Also, can Marissa attach the updated MAP sheet to the HubSpot record after she updates it? We use that to track approvals internally.

Leah
Leah Connor
Head of Integrations
Finera
leah.connor@finera.com

I updated MAP_v1.3.xlsx and uploaded to the HubSpot record (link in metadata). Changes made:
- Revised acceptance gate date to 2027-05-07 given current unblock timeline.
- Added a risk flag for "kernel-fallback under concurrent sessions" (severity: high).
- Assigned contingency task: if kernel fix misses EOD Wed, we will run a scoped canary on lower concurrency to keep some acceptance progress moving.

Karthik, can you confirm if the scoped canary requires any configuration changes on the Finera side? If not, we can run that independently and still attempt the full repro.

Action updates:
- Karthik Iyer: kernel profile + config diff (ETA: 2027-05-04 EOD)
- Rishi Malhotra: prepare rollback / fallback plan for the canary path (ETA: 2027-05-05)
- Irene: keep Fri 05/07 acceptance window and send final checklist to Finera on Thu 05/06 after sync.

I'll attach the checklist snapshot to the HubSpot deal and ping you when done.

—Marissa

Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval Runway — Weekly sprint report & POC milestone stalls

Thanks all — quick status update after today's sync:

- Karthik: shared a short kernel config patch that reduced fallback frequency by ~60% in local repro. Patch uploaded to the shared drive.
- Finera ops: initial warm-connection replay showed improved stability; logs attached to the HubSpot ticket.
- Decision: keep the 05/07 acceptance window but adopt scoped canary if the full concurrency run diverges >10% from baseline.

Next steps (confirmed):
- Karthik: finalize config patch and provide rollout steps (ETA: 2027-05-05 morning).
- Rishi: validate canary rollback playbook and put the runbook in the deal folder (ETA: 2027-05-05 afternoon).
- Marissa: confirm HubSpot attachments + notify Finera that checklist will be sent Thu morning.

If we still see >10% deviation on Fri, we escalate to the Dedicated/SRE on-call for a deeper kernel patch — Rishi will own that escalation.

I'll follow up after the Thu sync with a brief note and the final checklist. Thanks for the quick turn here.

Irene
